record.d: Nail clippers from Seki, Gifu, which ranks with Solingen and Sheffield among the world's three major cutlery centres and whose firm Kai holds Japan's top domestic share in nail clippers.

v.d: Kai's premium cutlery brand named after the swordsmith Magoroku Kanemoto

items.why: Ambiguous resolved as product: Seki-made nail clippers and cutlery are bought as such (Kai's Seki Magoroku line); the sword and blade-forging craft stays in Visual Entertainment. Seki kitchen knives belong to the kitchen-knife category, not here.

record.d: Brushes whose heads are made by hand in Kumano, Hiroshima, from uncut natural animal hair in more than 70 steps; a government-designated Traditional Craft (1975) and collective trademark (2004), made as calligraphy, paint and make-up brushes.
record.dt: hair: goat, horse, deer, raccoon dog, weasel, cat

items.why: A protected (collective trademark) brush you buy; origin version of Make-up brush.

record.d: An open razor entitled under the 1994 Solingen Regulation to bear the protected name Solingen because all major manufacturing stages were done in the Solingen industrial area (Solingen and Haan).

items.why: Protected designation for a product you buy. The regulation page names no makers; the existing archetypes Dovo Best Quality, Dovo Bismarck and Böker straight razor are Solingen makes and could become its versions at merge.

The fetched Cutlery of Thiers page names knives (Le Thiers, 1993) but no 'Thiers razor' product; Thiers razors are already represented by the Thiers-Issard razor archetype. Le Thiers knife belongs with pocket knives, not H1.
